title: Multi-Window SLO Burn-Rate Alerts
signature: class BurnRateAlerter: __init__(self, slo, rules), observe(self, minute, requests, errors) -> list, active(self) -> list
hints: Burn rate is the error ratio divided by the error budget: (sum of errors / sum of requests) / (1 - slo), summed over the window, not averaged per minute.
A rule fires only when BOTH its long and its short window are above the factor. The short window is what lets the alert clear quickly after recovery.
Keep one open/closed flag per severity. Emit an event only on a transition, never once per minute while firing.
A window of W minutes at minute m covers minutes m-W+1 .. m. Early in the stream it covers whatever has been observed.
